The synthetic-pdf-extract fixture is original test text, not an extraction from
Torn Apart or another real screenplay PDF. Its 65 manually annotated elements
span five scenes with PDF-style Action, cue, parenthetical and Dialogue columns,
physical wraps, inconsistent blank lines, changing page margins, a form-feed
inside speech, uppercase speech, and explicit character extensions.

The matching JSON describes the expected structured elements. Unit and browser
checks also repeat this fixture into a 100-scene document. The exact user example
is tested separately with all blank separators removed. No real PDF clipboard
sample was supplied; these tests do not establish arbitrary PDF compatibility.
